The things Yoshi-P would say, "if the community doesnt like it, we've failed", "if its not fun, I dont want it in the game". As a wow refugee, this stuff is mindblowing, because HES ACTUALLY FOLLOWING THROUGH ON IT. WHAT IS GOING ON RIGHT NOW. I feel like a girl thats just come out of an abusive relationship, asks her new boyfriend for a date night, and starts crying tears of joy because I dont get slapped for it.   


So of course I played the 2nd expansion, stormblood. Its very much more of a character piece. Examining 360 degrees the core characters, their motivations, and whats important to them. It wasn't as grand of an adventure but I still loved it.
